It asks for a secret code, PIN, BVN or card details.
Never share these with anyone, even if they say they are your bank.
It says your account has a problem and asks you to act.
Don\'t click or call. Ask your family, or go to your bank yourself.
It promises a prize, job or loan but wants money or a click first.
Real prizes and jobs don\'t ask you to pay first. Don\'t pay.
It claims to be a bank or official and asks for money or a click.
Banks never ask like this. Call your family before you do anything.
It asks you to send money or open a link.
Make sure you know the sender. Call them on the number you know first.
It pushes you to act fast and to call or reply.
Take your time. Call your family before you reply.
Call your family before you reply, click or pay.
It says your account has a problem or promises you something, and asks you to act.
Don\'t click, call or pay. Ask your family first.
It asks for money in a hurry, or from a new number.
Call the person on the number you already know before you send anything.
It wants you to open a link or call a number.
Don\'t click or call. Ask your family first.

Red warning on the lock screen
So the red warning can fill the screen, even when the phone is locked. On the next screen, turn on Argus, then come back.
So the phone doesn\'t stop Argus to save battery. It uses very little.
One more setting for this phone
Tecno, Infinix and itel phones stop apps in the background. Turn on Auto-start for Argus:
1. Open Settings and search for \"Auto-start\" (or open Phone Master).
2. Find Argus and turn it on.
Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones need three settings for Argus:
1. Tap \"Open App info\" below and turn on \"Autostart\".
2. Tap \"Other permissions\" and allow \"Show on lock screen\".
3. In the same list, allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in background\".
Then come back here and tap \"I\'ve done this\".

Recommended. So the red warning can cover the screen while the phone is in use, not only when it is locked. On the next screen, turn on Argus, then come back.

Argus works offline. It has no internet permission, so no message can ever leave this phone.
When a text message or WhatsApp message arrives, Argus reads it here on this phone.
Clear scam signs, like a link with \"your BVN is blocked\", raise the alarm at once.
Everything else is checked by Gemma, an AI model by Google that runs on this phone.
If a message looks like a scam, the phone shows a red warning and speaks. It never tells you a message is safe: if in doubt, call your family.
Your messages stay on this phone
Messages are never saved and never sent anywhere. The only thing Argus can send is the text to your family when a scam arrives, and that text never includes the message or who sent it.
